svg.title: Applications, messages and files on one IBM platform
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Applications connect: IBM App Connect offers more than 200 prebuilt connectors and templates, authored on premises, in containers or as SaaS. Messages arrive once: IBM says MQ is designed to never lose a message, with exactly-once delivery, native high availability and cross-region replication. Files move at scale: IBM Aspera, powered by FASP technology, moves large files across distance, latency and unpredictable networks.
